correctness.rationale: PASS — Checked the exact unbiased edge-picking/copying update law, random iid fair start, attempted updates including null changes, and independent exponential(rate n) continuous-time clock. Transient complementary configuration rate matrix Q has diagonal sum n d_s(v)/(2|E|) and negative flip rates; Q m_1=1 and Q m_2=2 m_1, averaging 2^{n-1} complement classes with absorbing starts contributes zero. K and T obey ET=EK/n and Var(T)=(Var(K)+EK)/n^2, so count-variance and time-variance signs must be tested separately. The finite universe of connected unlabeled graphs n=2..5 has (1,2,6,21) classes and (0,1,11,80) graph/nonedge tests. A separate exact rational solver over networkx.graph_atlas_g (not repository verifier) obtained opposite-sign counts for (time-mean, time-variance) and (count-mean, count-variance) respectively n4 (3,0) and n5 (0,1), zero below. The n4 positives are equivalent star-leaf additions; the n5 reverse is K5 minus edges 01,24,34 then add 01. This is a complete finite proof via all unlabeled graph classes, not a claimed large-n theorem.
